youtube.baslik: Why does an auditory-verbal therapist coach the parent, not just the child? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In parent coaching, the therapist passes skills on to the parent, making the parent the child's main teacher. The therapist first briefly explains the goal of the activity, then demonstrates the strategy with the child; next the parent tries the same activity while the therapist steps back and observes. Feedback starts with what the parent did well, then focuses on a single small suggestion; the main work happens at home during the rest of the week, within daily life.
